text:
# BioImage AI

BioImage AI: A computer vision module for automated analysis of microscopy images, performing tasks like cell counting and morphology assessment.
split_caveat: Automatic punctuation-based unit; abbreviations, formulas and compound sentences may require manual split/merge. No semantic pass implied.
evidence_and_limit: Classical threshold/distance/shape processing exists; synthetic supplied-label area=24 and integrated intensity=42 reproduce. This tranche did not inspect actual pixels or establish segmentation-quality pass.

text: It uses deep learning to correct segmentation errors and provides quantitative data on culture health.
split_caveat: Automatic punctuation-based unit; abbreviations, formulas and compound sentences may require manual split/merge. No semantic pass implied.
evidence_and_limit: Gaussian background, Otsu/adaptive thresholds, regional maxima and Voronoi split, not trained deep learning. Culture-health score is heuristic.

text: BioImage AI accelerates the analysis of phenotypic screens, turning visual data into actionable scientific insights.
split_caveat: Automatic punctuation-based unit; abbreviations, formulas and compound sentences may require manual split/merge. No semantic pass implied.
evidence_and_limit: Image/cell diagnostics exist; prior separate BBBC001 count benchmark was 8.1824% mean deviation, not published 6.2% or whole phenotype-screen validity.

# Enterprise Bio

Enterprise Bio: A comprehensive computational tier breakdown for SugarCode AI, outlining access levels from academic research to industrial integration.
split_caveat: Automatic punctuation-based unit; abbreviations, formulas and compound sentences may require manual split/merge. No semantic pass implied.
evidence_and_limit: Tier/quota table and local entitlement classes exist. Quota 99 accepted then 2 denied with 1 remaining, chain verifies. Caller-index module-gate trust gap recorded separately.

text: It details features like robotic lab automation and private data vaults.
split_caveat: Automatic punctuation-based unit; abbreviations, formulas and compound sentences may require manual split/merge. No semantic pass implied.
evidence_and_limit: Fernet file-backed per-tenant vault and in-memory job lifecycle/export implemented; not connected physical robotic lab execution. Private-vault/security efficacy not broadly audited here.

text: Enterprise Bio offers scalable solutions for biotechnology companies, providing the computational power needed for large-scale discovery and high-throughput engineering.
split_caveat: Automatic punctuation-based unit; abbreviations, formulas and compound sentences may require manual split/merge. No semantic pass implied.
evidence_and_limit: Local classes and static tier claims, no deployed scale/load/SLA evidence or real compute availability verified. Prices are source constants, not verified commercial offerings.

# Microbiome Exp

Microbiome Exp: A taxonomic analysis engine for 16S rRNA data, providing diversity indices, taxonomic distributions, and functional potential summaries.
split_caveat: Automatic punctuation-based unit; abbreviations, formulas and compound sentences may require manual split/merge. No semantic pass implied.
evidence_and_limit: Genus counts/cohort statistics exist; not raw 16S sequencing taxonomic inference. Independent balanced Shannon=ln(2), Bray=.5, repeated.

text: It correlates microbial profiles with publication trends and disease states, offering a comprehensive view of interactions.
split_caveat: Automatic punctuation-based unit; abbreviations, formulas and compound sentences may require manual split/merge. No semantic pass implied.
evidence_and_limit: Static disease genus flags and placeholder publication_trend_link, no publication-trend retrieval/correlation in core source.

text: Microbiome Exp provides the data necessary for understanding the microbiome's role in human health.
split_caveat: Automatic punctuation-based unit; abbreviations, formulas and compound sentences may require manual split/merge. No semantic pass implied.
evidence_and_limit: Descriptive counts and functional annotation lookups, disease associations not diagnosis; microbial health mechanism accuracy not established.

text:
# Microbiome Rx

Microbiome Rx: A simulation engine for metabolic interactions within microbial communities, predicting how diet or antibiotics alter the flux of key metabolites.
split_caveat: Automatic punctuation-based unit; abbreviations, formulas and compound sentences may require manual split/merge. No semantic pass implied.
evidence_and_limit: Species/metabolite ODE uses curated growth/interactions and supplied diet/antibiotic effects; no calibrated measured human metabolite flux.

text: It enables the design of interventions that restore healthy metabolic function to dysbiotic microbiomes.
split_caveat: Automatic punctuation-based unit; abbreviations, formulas and compound sentences may require manual split/merge. No semantic pass implied.
evidence_and_limit: Differential-evolution diet optimizer compares model targets/achieved and convergence. Does not establish restoration of real healthy metabolic function.

text: Microbiome Rx provides insights into the functional state, helping researchers develop targeted strategies.
split_caveat: Automatic punctuation-based unit; abbreviations, formulas and compound sentences may require manual split/merge. No semantic pass implied.
evidence_and_limit: Trajectory/diagnostics and intervention ranking exist, source disclaims clinical response; no actual targeted clinical strategy validity.
